thread:
alana: Quick huddle — we need a concrete miniwave plan for post-launch: prioritize customer-blocking fixes, clear up the top stability regressions, and still ship a few UX polish items. Who's in? :wave:

mike: In. Can we pick a split so eng knows what to staff?

jasmin: Current telemetry: 9 high-ish regressions (streaming disconnects, tokenization edgecases), ~16 medium, ~11 low. 3 customer-blocking reports flagged by support.

omar: Heads up: 2 of those customers are Dedicated, one is mid-enterprise; they want ETA and a channel.

alana: Proposal: carve into "hot", "stability", "polish" lanes. Hot = customer-blocking + 2 worst P1s (target TTR 48h). Stability = majority of remaining high/medium for a 2-week miniwave (60% capacity). Polish = small UX fixes, 1-2 day PRs (reserve 40% capacity). Keeps SLAs while delivering visible wins.

rachel: Design can batch the polish items into 3 PRs if we limit scope. I can own reviews.

mike: Capacity note: if 60% goes to stability, who handles infra and regular ops? Need an oncall plan.

jasmin: Suggest a 2-person core for stability work; rotate 2 others to infra/oncall. Escalate to hot lane if new P1 appears.

alana: Promotion rules to hot lane: customer-blocking OR error-rate spike >1% with reproducible trace OR Dedicated-customer incident. Agree?

leo: Agree on Dedicated auto-promote. Also call out streaming/KV-cache regressions as high-impact.

omar: I'll ping the three customers with an ETA and hotfix channel offer.

product-bot: Canary deploy scheduled at 18:00 PT for quick patch.

alana: Action items: mike -> triage and assign hot lane owners today; jasmin -> publish stability sprint plan + capacity sheet by EOD; rachel -> bundle polish PRs by tomorrow noon; omar -> notify customers and offer hotfix channel. Post blockers here. :thumbsup:

mike: On it. Hot lane owners by 10:30am.

jasmin: Note: treat any streaming/KV-cache linked regression as automatic high. They cause the worst UX drops.

alana: Target: close top 10 bugs and ship 4-6 quick wins in the 2-week miniwave. Mid-sprint check Friday 16:00 PT.

maya: I'll take the Dedicated customer fixes if assigned.

leo: Triage done — assigning owners now: @maya (Dedicated fixes), @jasmin (streaming), @leo (latency investigations).

omar: Customer messages sent with proposed TTRs. One asked for call; scheduling.

rachel: PRs opened for the 3 small UX items, ready for review tomorrow.

alana: Great. If anything blocks delivery we re-evaluate scope at the mid-sprint check. Thanks everyone.

product-bot: Reminder set for Friday 16:00 PT — #product miniwave check-in.
